queue.title: PSUR Submissions in South Africa: Structuring a Report SAHPRA Won't Reject
queue.notes: How SAHPRA's pharmacovigilance guideline and ICH E2 series expectations shape PSUR structure and content, common gaps between a global PSUR and what SAHPRA requires locally, benefit-risk narrative pitfalls, and how a GVP-aligned risk management plan should cross-reference the PSUR.

queue.title: Why Fact-Checking Is the First Compliance Control in Regulated Publishing
queue.notes: Why verifying claims against authoritative sources before publication is a compliance control, not an editorial nicety, especially across legal, medical, and agricultural publishing where an unverified claim carries real liability; what a defensible source-verification workflow looks like, and the review-process gaps that most often let an error through.

queue.title: Records of Advice Under FAIS: What a Fair Conduct Compliant Record Actually Contains
queue.notes: What the FAIS Act requires a record of advice to demonstrate, how FSCA's Treating Customers Fairly expectations and incoming CoFI Bill fair-conduct obligations raise the bar beyond a signed disclosure form, and the gaps most often found between what an adviser discussed and what the record actually proves.

queue.title: Drafting Collective Agreements That Survive an LRA Challenge
queue.notes: Common drafting failures in collective agreements that create exposure under the LRA, how BCEA and National Minimum Wage Act provisions interact with (and sometimes override) negotiated terms, and what a pre-signature compliance review should check before a clause becomes a dispute.

queue.title: Vertical Agreements and Resale Price Maintenance: What Competition Law Actually Prohibits
queue.notes: What the Competition Act and Competition Commission guidelines actually prohibit in distribution and pricing agreements, the difference between lawful minimum advertised price policies and unlawful resale price maintenance, and the contract clauses that most often draw Commission scrutiny.

queue.title: Tender Bid Responsiveness Under the Public Procurement Act: What Disqualifies a Bid
queue.notes: How bid responsiveness is assessed under the Public Procurement Act and PPPFA Regulations, the documentation and B-BBEE verification gaps that most often disqualify an otherwise competitive bid, and how to structure a pre-submission compliance check against the tender's own conditions.

queue.title: PAIA Manuals Under POPIA: What's Actually Required and Why Most Fall Short
queue.notes: What a PAIA manual must actually contain now that POPIA has folded private-body PAIA obligations into the broader data protection regime, the gap between a generic template and a manual that reflects an organisation's real processing activities, and how FICA risk management programme obligations overlap with POPIA for accountable institutions.

queue.title: Agrochemical Label Compliance Under Act 36 of 1947: The Claims That Get Products Rejected
queue.notes: Registration and labelling requirements for agricultural remedies under Act 36 of 1947, how APS Act produce grading and marking rules interact with export documentation, and the label claims and MRL-related statements that most often trigger a rejection or recall.

queue.title: Section 54 Notices Under the Mine Health and Safety Act: How to Avoid a Stoppage
queue.notes: What triggers a section 54 instruction under the MHSA, the documentation and Code of Practice gaps that inspectors most often cite, how MPRDA and NEMA environmental authorisation conditions intersect with safety compliance, and what a pre-inspection internal audit should cover.

queue.title: NERSA Generation Licence Applications: The Documentation Gaps That Delay IPP Projects
queue.notes: What a NERSA generation licence application under the Electricity Regulation Act must demonstrate, how grid-code documentation and environmental authorisation packages need to align before submission, and where IFC Performance Standards add additional documentation requirements for DFI-financed IPP projects.

queue.title: Environmental Authorisation Conditions: Why Compliance Audits Fail After the EIA Is Approved
queue.notes: Why an approved EIA report is the start of compliance obligations under NEMA, not the end, how water use and waste management licence conditions are commonly missed in post-approval monitoring, and what an environmental compliance audit should check against the authorisation's actual conditions.

queue.title: PMB Funding Decisions: What Regulation 15I(c) Actually Requires of Medical Scheme Protocols
queue.notes: What Regulation 15I(c) under the Medical Schemes Act requires a scheme's clinical and funding protocols to demonstrate for PMB conditions, common gaps between a scheme's treatment algorithm and what the CMS expects it to show, and how rule amendments should be checked for PMB compliance before implementation.
